# Superclawdtural

> The Superclawdtural showcase page for Clawd Clash, a free macOS app that shows your AI coding sessions (Claude Code, and the other AIs and harnesses it supports) as a pixel-art battle on the desktop or in a window. Every session is a hero or a villain, every subagent joins in, and they fight while they work. This repo holds no code: it only shows off the Superclawdtural universe (pictures, a promo video and a plain-language changelog).

- Superclawdtural is the Supernatural parody universe of Clawd Clash, from all fifteen seasons: 45 villains and 34 heroes (Dean and Sam Winclawdster, Clawdstiel, Bobby Clawdsinger, Jack, Mary and John Winclawdster, Ellen and Jo Harvell, Charlie Clawdbury, Rowena MacClawd, Garth Fitzclawd IV, Jody Mills, Clawdley, Azazel, Meg, Ruby, Lilith, Abaddon, Lucifer, Michael, Dick Roman, Chuck, the Horsemen, Death and more) and 20 places (the Bunker, Singer Salvage, Harvelle's Roadhouse, a motel room, the crossroads, Stull Cemetery, Clawdley's Hell, Heaven, Purgatory, the Empty, the open road and more).
- Set pieces: Baby, the '67 Impala, picks up whoever's done; Back from Hell on context compaction (dragged under by hellhounds, a fist punching back up out of the ground); Clawdstiel standing too close; "Bitch." "Jerk."; devil's-trap and angel-blade practice; Abaddon's telekinetic grip; twelve transitions (The Road So Far, Headlights, Salt and Burn, the Devil's Trap, Smoke Out, Angel Light, Hellhound, Cold Spot, the Ghostfacers Cam, Motel Wallpaper, the Leviathan Maw, Chuck's Rewrite).
- Install: Superclawdtural is coming in Clawd Clash 4.1.0 (`brew tap rodclemen/tap && brew install --cask clawd-clash`, then Settings → Universe → Superclawdtural).
- The app, its source, docs and full history: https://github.com/rodclemen/clawd-clash
- The other universes: Star Clawds, Marvelous Clawds, Detective Clawds, Doctor Clawd, The Clawd Files, Stevie Clawdberg, Clawd of the Rings, Clawd Slayer and Stranger Clawds, and Clawd Royale, which puts them all in one scene.
